demos.name: Shiny Text
demos.description: A band of light sweeps across the text, like light catching metal.

demos.name: Gradient Text
demos.description: Text filled with a flowing, seamlessly looping gradient. Optional animated border.

demos.name: Blur Text
demos.description: Words or letters come into focus from a blur, one after another. Click to replay.

demos.name: Split Text
demos.description: Letters (or words) rise into place one after another with a springy overshoot. Optional line mask for a pull-up reveal.

demos.name: Decrypted Text
demos.description: Characters scramble through random symbols, then lock into place one by one. Hover the lower lines to decode them again.

demos.name: Typewriter
demos.description: Types one or more strings, pauses, deletes and types the next, with a smoothly blinking cursor.

demos.name: Rotating Text
demos.description: Cycles through words with a per-letter staggered slide inside a pill that resizes to fit, or a blur flip.

demos.name: Count Up
demos.description: Numbers count to their target with easing, tabular digits, separators, decimals and prefixes. Changing the target animates from the current value.

demos.name: Sliding Number
demos.description: An odometer: each digit rolls vertically on a spring when the value changes, carrying past 9 like a real counter.

demos.name: Glitch Text
demos.description: Slices of the text jump sideways with red/cyan channel splits in short, violent bursts.

demos.name: Fuzzy Text
demos.description: Thin rows of the text jitter sideways every frame like a noisy signal; hover to crank up the fuzz.

demos.name: Circular Text
demos.description: Text set around a slowly rotating ring; hovering spins it faster.
demos.code:
ui.add(CircularText::new("GLOWKIT • ANIMATED • RUST • ").center_text("✦"));
ui.add(CircularText::new("hover to slow down * ").on_hover(HoverSpin::SlowDown));

demos.name: Scroll Velocity
demos.description: Huge rows of text marquee in opposite directions forever; scroll over them to kick the speed (scrolling up reverses).

demos.name: Wave Text
demos.description: Letters bob on a travelling sine wave, optionally with a gradient riding the crest.
demos.code:
ui.add(WaveText::new("Riding the wave").size(52.0));
ui.add(WaveText::new("with a gradient").colors(&theme.gradient));

demos.name: Proximity Text
demos.description: Letters near the pointer swell, thicken and shift color, nudging their neighbours aside.

demos.name: True Focus
demos.description: One word at a time snaps into focus inside animated corner brackets while the rest stay blurred.

demos.name: Sparkles Text
demos.description: Text with little four-pointed stars that pop in, twinkle and fade around it.

demos.name: Morphing Text
demos.description: Words melt into each other: the old one dissolves into a blur as the next condenses out of it.

demos.name: Text Generate
demos.description: A paragraph streams in word by word, each word fading out of a blur, like an AI response.
covers: Magic UI: Text Animate (blurIn by word)

demos.name: Highlight Text
demos.description: Animated emphasis drawn onto a phrase: marker swipe, underline, box, hand-drawn circle or strike-through.

demos.name: Colorful Text
demos.description: Each letter takes a color from a palette; every few seconds they reshuffle in a little blur-and-bounce wave.

demos.name: Gradual Spacing
demos.description: Letters start squeezed together and spread out to their natural spacing as they fade in.

demos.name: Text Roll
demos.description: Letters roll up and out while copies roll in from below, staggered. Holds while hovered; great for menus.

demos.name: Shuffle Text
demos.description: Each letter is a little slot-machine reel that spins through random letters and lands on the real one.

demos.name: Scroll Reveal
demos.description: A paragraph whose words brighten progressively from faint to full, driven by time, your own progress value or its scroll position.
demos.code:
ui.add(ScrollRevealText::new("When does a man die? ...").scroll_linked());
ui.add(ScrollRevealText::new("Driven by a slider").progress(progress));

demos.name: Line Shadow Text
demos.description: Bold text with an offset shadow made of diagonal stripes that keep sliding through it.

demos.name: Falling Text
demos.description: Click and the words drop under gravity, tumble, bounce and pile up; drag through the pile to shove them, click again to send them home.

demos.name: Animated Underline
demos.description: Link text whose underline draws in from the left on hover and slides out to the right when the pointer leaves.

demos.name: Scramble Hover
demos.description: Letters dissolve into flickering symbols while hovered and resolve back left to right when the pointer leaves.

demos.name: Box Reveal
demos.description: A solid box sweeps across each line and slides away, uncovering text that rises in behind it.
demos.code:
ui.add(BoxReveal::new("Magic UI.").size(64.0));
ui.add(BoxReveal::new("UI library for egui").delay(0.2).size(24.0));

demos.name: Curved Loop
demos.description: A text marquee flowing endlessly along a curved path. Drag it to scrub; throw it and it keeps running that way.
demos.code:
ui.add(CurvedLoopText::new("Welcome to glowkit")
    .curve(80.0)
    .speed(80.0));
ui.add(CurvedLoopText::new("Bend it like Rust")
    .curve(-40.0)
    .gradient(&palettes::MAGIC)
    .reverse(true));

demos.name: Text Cursor
demos.description: A trail of little text or emoji stamps pops out behind the pointer, wobbling and drifting as it fades. A ghost pointer draws loops when you are away.

demos.name: Scroll Float
demos.description: Letters float up out of the line, tall and squeezed at first, settling into shape one after another as the progress grows. Driven by time, a progress value or a scroll area.

demos.name: ASCII Text
demos.description: Big lettering redrawn as animated ASCII art: denser symbols where there is more ink, rippled by a flowing wave and tinted with a drifting gradient. The pointer bends it like a lens.

demos.name: Scrambled Text
demos.description: A paragraph whose letters dissolve into flickering symbols near the pointer and settle back into place after a moment.

demos.name: Comic Text
demos.description: Chunky comic-book lettering with a thick ink outline, a hard drop shadow and a halftone dot pattern, popping in with a springy twist.

demos.name: Video Text
demos.description: Huge letters that act as a window onto a moving scene (aurora, ocean, lava or plasma) flowing continuously across the whole word.

demos.name: Text Reveal Card
demos.description: Drag or hover across the card: left of a glowing divider, a hidden line of text shows through with twinkling stars.

demos.name: Text Hover Effect
demos.description: A huge outlined word; a radial gradient follows the pointer and lights the outline in color around it.

demos.name: Pointer Highlight
demos.description: A rectangle draws itself around a phrase while a pointer cursor glides to its corner, as if someone just highlighted it.
demos.code: ui.add(PointerHighlight::new("The best way to grow is to ", "collaborate", "."));

demos.name: Cover
demos.description: Text in a box that turns into hyperspace on hover: streaking beams, sparkles, glowing corners and jittering text.

demos.name: Aurora
demos.description: Flowing curtains of northern light that drift and shimmer, fading into the background.

demos.name: Particles
demos.description: Drifting particles with depth, optional constellation links and pointer repulsion.

demos.name: Squares Grid
demos.description: An endlessly scrolling grid; the hovered square fills in and fades as you move on.

demos.name: Dot Grid
demos.description: A field of dots that bulges away from the pointer and springs back with a wobble. Click for a shockwave.
covers: Aceternity UI: Grid and Dot Backgrounds

demos.name: Grid Pattern
demos.description: Thin grid lines with squares fading in and out at random, a hover highlight and an optional skew.
covers: Aceternity UI: Grid and Dot Backgrounds

demos.name: Retro Grid
demos.description: A perspective grid floor scrolling toward the viewer, fading at the horizon.

demos.name: Flickering Grid
demos.description: A grid of tiny squares each flickering to random opacities, like a quiet LED panel.

demos.name: Meteors
demos.description: Meteor streaks with glowing heads and fading tails falling diagonally at random speeds.

demos.name: Shooting Stars
demos.description: Twinkling stars with shooting stars streaking across every couple of seconds.

demos.name: Background Beams
demos.description: Faint curved paths sweeping across the area with pulses of colored light racing along them.

demos.name: Wavy Background
demos.description: Thick, blurred ribbons of color undulating like slow ocean waves.

demos.name: Waves
demos.description: Dozens of thin lines warped by flowing noise; the pointer drags them and they spring back.

demos.name: Threads
demos.description: Fine threads fanning out from a bundle into flowing, rippling strands that lean toward the pointer.

demos.name: Silk
demos.description: Smooth, undulating folds of shaded silk with soft specular highlights.

demos.name: Iridescence
demos.description: An oily, iridescent rainbow film that swirls and shifts; the pointer stirs it.

demos.name: Swirl
demos.description: Psychedelic paint swirling into a slowly spinning vortex with marbled bands.

demos.name: Liquid Metal
demos.description: Rippling liquid chrome with flowing reflections; the pointer sends ripples through it.

demos.name: Plasma
demos.description: Classic demoscene plasma: interfering sine fields mapped to a glowing, looping palette.

demos.name: Lightning
demos.description: A crackling bolt with a white-hot core, wide glow and flickering branches.

demos.name: Orb
demos.description: A glowing ring of colored light with a breathing edge that ripples and spins faster on hover.

demos.name: Warp Speed
demos.description: Hyperspace star streaks rushing toward the viewer. Press and hold to engage warp.

demos.name: Galaxy
demos.description: A slowly rotating spiral galaxy with a bright core and colorful arms. Stars scatter from the pointer.

demos.name: Letter Glitch
demos.description: A wall of monospace letters constantly glitching to new characters and colors, with a vignette.

demos.name: Matrix Rain
demos.description: Columns of glyphs raining down with bright heads and fading trails.

demos.name: Ripple
demos.description: Concentric circles breathing in a staggered wave, fading toward the bottom.

demos.name: Spotlight
demos.description: Volumetric light rays fanning down from above, swaying and shimmering, leaning toward the pointer.

demos.name: Lamp
demos.description: A bright bar of light widening into view and casting a fan of colored light upward.

demos.name: Vortex
demos.description: Hundreds of glowing particles swirling into a vortex with short colorful trails.

demos.name: Gradient Blobs
demos.description: Big soft blobs of color drifting and blending like a lava lamp, one following the pointer.

demos.name: Mesh Gradient
demos.description: A smoothly animated four-color mesh gradient with organic swirl and distortion.

demos.name: Snowfall
demos.description: Gently falling snow with depth: distant flakes small and slow, near ones big and swaying.

demos.name: Grain Noise
demos.description: Animated film grain overlay that gives gradients an analog texture (right half).

demos.name: Background Boxes
demos.description: A skewed isometric grid of boxes that light up in random colors under the pointer.

demos.name: Beams
demos.description: Tall columns of soft light with luminous texture flowing down them; rotate for a diagonal look.

demos.name: Hex Grid
demos.description: A honeycomb of hexagons with random pulses, a rolling wave of light and a pointer glow.

demos.name: Liquid Ether
demos.description: A real-time fluid simulation: moving the pointer stirs glowing eddies of color that curl, mix and slowly fade. A ghost pointer keeps it alive.

demos.name: Grid Scan
demos.description: A wireframe grid tunnel receding into the distance, swept by a glowing scan frame that lights up the lines it passes. The view leans toward the pointer.

demos.name: Prismatic Burst
demos.description: Rays of rainbow light bursting from the center, rotating, flickering and breathing, with shock rings rippling outward.

demos.name: Grid Motion
demos.description: A tilted wall of tiles whose rows slide in opposite directions as the pointer moves, each with its own lag, for a deep parallax feel.

demos.name: Laser Flow
demos.description: A laser beam falls from the top and splashes across a surface, wrapped in luminous fog that curls outward and up.

demos.name: Metallic Paint
demos.description: A shape or logo filled with flowing liquid metal: rippling chrome bands, a bevelled rim and a highlight that follows the pointer.

demos.name: Background Lines
demos.description: Long flowing curves sweep across the area, drawing themselves in, lingering and erasing again, each on its own rhythm and in its own color.

demos.name: Dotted Map
demos.description: A world map drawn as a grid of dots, with glowing arcs flying between cities one after another and markers rippling where they land.

demos.name: Meta Balls
demos.description: Organic blobs that merge and split like liquid, colored by the dominant blob; one follows the pointer.
demos.code:
ui.add(MetaBalls::new().count(9));
// behind other content: MetaBalls::new().paint_at(ui, rect, pointer_pos)

demos.name: Ball Pit
demos.description: Glossy balls with gravity, collisions and bounce; the pointer shoves them around and an invisible hand stirs them when idle.

demos.name: Ripple Grid
demos.description: Grid lines rippling with waves from the center and the pointer, crests lit in the accent color.

demos.name: Dark Veil
demos.description: A dark, slowly flowing veil of tinted light, like light through smoke.

demos.name: Color Bends
demos.description: Bands of vivid color that bend and flow, leaning toward the pointer.

demos.name: Gradient Blinds
demos.description: Venetian-blind slats of flowing gradient, each lit across its width, with a spotlight that follows the pointer.

demos.name: Pixel Blast / Dither
demos.description: Animated noise or waves quantized with a 4x4 Bayer ordered dither into pixels, dots or diamonds; ripples burst from the pointer.

demos.name: Faulty Terminal
demos.description: A glitchy green CRT: flickering glyphs under a brightness wave, scanlines, rolling interference and row glitches.

demos.name: Shimmer Button
demos.description: A dark pill with a spark of light racing around its border and an inner glow that rises on hover.

demos.name: Shiny Button
demos.description: A subtle surface button whose label and border catch a band of light sweeping across.

demos.name: Rainbow Button
demos.description: A high-contrast button with a flowing rainbow border and a blurred rainbow glow pooled beneath it.

demos.name: Pulsating Button
demos.description: A solid call-to-action that sends soft rings of color pulsing outward like a heartbeat.

demos.name: Ripple Button
demos.description: Material-style ink ripples spread from wherever you click, clipped to the button's rounded shape.

demos.name: Interactive Hover Button
demos.description: A dot beside the label swells to fill the pill on hover while a new label and arrow slide in.
demos.code:
ui.add(InteractiveHoverButton::new("Book a demo"));
ui.add(InteractiveHoverButton::new("Hover me").hover_label("Let's go"));

demos.name: Moving Border
demos.description: A glowing blob of light endlessly orbits the button's thin border.

demos.name: Hover Border Gradient
demos.description: A highlight circles the pill's border; on hover the light spreads over the whole border in color.

demos.name: Star Border
demos.description: Two stars of light glide along the top and bottom edges in opposite directions.

demos.name: Magnetic Button
demos.description: The button is pulled toward the pointer as it approaches and springs back when it leaves.

demos.name: Glow Button
demos.description: A glossy gradient pill floating on a breathing pool of its own colored light; it lifts on hover.

demos.name: Neon Button
demos.description: An outlined neon tube with glowing text that occasionally flickers, and floods with light on hover.

demos.name: Liquid Fill Button
demos.description: Liquid with a wavy surface rises inside the outline on hover, flipping the label color as it passes.

demos.name: Stateful Button
demos.description: Idle, then a spinner while loading, then a drawn check mark on success, resizing smoothly between states.

demos.name: Animated Subscribe Button
demos.description: A toggle that slides between two labels, gaining a check mark and a new color when active.

demos.name: Copy Button
demos.description: Copies text to the clipboard; the copy icon morphs into a check mark, then back.
demos.code:
ui.add(CopyButton::new("cargo add glowkit"));
ui.add(CopyButton::new("npm i glowkit").label("Copy"));

demos.name: Particle Burst Button
demos.description: Click to burst confetti, sparkles and dots out of the button (hold to keep spraying).

demos.name: 3D Push Button
demos.description: A chunky key you physically push: it pops up on hover and sinks on press with a bouncy spring.

demos.name: Pixel Button
demos.description: A retro 8-bit button with stair-stepped corners, a chunky bevel and a pixel drop shadow.

demos.name: Gradient Outline Button
demos.description: A transparent button outlined by a rotating gradient that floods the button on hover.

demos.name: Arrow Slide Button
demos.description: On hover the label nudges aside and the arrow chip shoots its arrow out while a new one slides in.

demos.name: Glass Icons
demos.description: Frosted glass tiles floating over tilted, vividly colored backplates; hover swings the plate and lifts the glass.

demos.name: Script Copy Button
demos.description: An install command with package-manager tabs and a copy button whose clipboard morphs into a check with a 'Copied!' bubble.

demos.name: Animated Theme Toggler
demos.description: A sun that morphs into a crescent moon; switching sweeps a circular reveal of the new theme across the area.

demos.name: Border Beam
demos.description: A comet of light travels around the border, fading from one color to another along its tail.

demos.name: Shine Border
demos.description: A band of multi-colored light drifts diagonally around the card's border.

demos.name: Magic Card
demos.description: A spotlight follows the pointer inside the card while the border lights up in a gradient around it.

demos.name: Spotlight Card
demos.description: A dark card lit by a soft spotlight that follows the pointer, optionally revealing a dot grid.

demos.name: Tilt Card
demos.description: The card tilts in 3D toward the pointer with real perspective, a moving glare and parallax content.

demos.name: Glare Card
demos.description: A diagonal streak of glare sweeps across the card on hover, with a soft sheen under the pointer.

demos.name: Neon Gradient Card
demos.description: A card wrapped in an animated two-tone gradient border that bleeds a big neon glow around it.

demos.name: Glowing Border Card
demos.description: The border lights up in a multi-color arc on the side facing the pointer, gliding around as it moves.

demos.name: Encrypted Card
demos.description: Scrambled characters are revealed over a glowing gradient in a circle around the pointer.

demos.name: Pixel Card
demos.description: Shimmering pixels fill the card on hover, spreading out from the center.

demos.name: Glass Card
demos.description: A frosted-glass card with a translucent fill, a light-catching rim and a soft shadow.

demos.name: Wobble Card
demos.description: A bold card wobbles toward the pointer on a springy band while its content drifts the other way.

demos.name: Card Hover Effect
demos.description: A soft highlight slab slides between cards in a grid, following the pointer.

demos.name: Hover Lift Card
demos.description: The card rises toward you on hover: a deeper shadow, an accent glow and a warmer border.

demos.name: Focus Cards
demos.description: The hovered card stays in focus while the others shrink back, dim and haze over.

demos.name: Electric Border
demos.description: A jittery, crackling border of electricity with layered glow.

demos.name: Animated Gradient Border
demos.description: A conic gradient keeps rotating around the border, optionally with a matching glow.

demos.name: Marching Border
demos.description: Dashes march around the border like a selection marquee or a drop zone.

demos.name: Magic Bento
demos.description: A bento grid where a spotlight follows the pointer and lights card borders; the hovered card tilts and sparkles with particles.

demos.name: Chroma Grid
demos.description: Profile tiles rendered in grayscale, with a circle of full color that follows the pointer across the grid.

demos.name: Profile Card
demos.description: A holographic trading-card profile that tilts toward the pointer while rainbow foil and a glare slide across it.

demos.name: Glass Surface
demos.description: A refracting glass panel: the backdrop bends and compresses toward its rim with color fringes and specular edges.

demos.name: Fluid Glass
demos.description: A liquid glass lens that glides after the pointer, magnifying and bending everything beneath it with rainbow edges.

demos.name: Decay Card
demos.description: A poster card whose picture tears and ripples with turbulence as the pointer moves over it, then slowly heals.

demos.name: Pixel Transition
demos.description: A card that swaps to its second face through a pixel dissolve: squares pop in at random, then away again.

demos.name: Direction Aware Hover
demos.description: A card whose caption overlay slides in from the edge the pointer entered through, and leaves the way it exits.

demos.name: Glowing Stars Card
demos.description: A card with a grid of tiny stars where random ones softly glow; more of them light up on hover.
demos.code: ui.add(GlowingStarsCard::new("Next-gen rendering", "Crisp, animated UI on every platform."));

demos.name: Canvas Reveal Effect
demos.description: On hover a flickering dot-matrix ripples out from the center of the card while the icon lifts and the title appears.

demos.name: 3D Pin
demos.description: A card that tilts back in perspective on hover while a pin rises from its center with a label and pulsing rings.

demos.name: Click Spark
demos.description: Lines of light burst outward from every click. Wraps any area without stealing its clicks.

demos.name: Click Ripple
demos.description: Concentric rings ripple out from each click like a drop hitting water.

demos.name: Pointer Trail
demos.description: A glowing comet tail chases the pointer and shrinks away when it stops.

demos.name: Ribbons
demos.description: Silky ribbons chase the pointer on springs of different stiffness, weaving around each other.

demos.name: Pixel Trail
demos.description: Cells of an invisible grid light up under the pointer and fade out, leaving a pixelated trail.

demos.name: Card Trail
demos.description: Moving the pointer drops a trail of cards that pop in, tilt and shrink away (image trail).

demos.name: Blob Cursor
demos.description: Gooey blobs chase the pointer with growing lag and melt into each other like liquid.

demos.name: Smooth Cursor
demos.description: A custom cursor glides after the pointer on a spring, turning to face its direction of travel.

demos.name: Following Pointer
demos.description: A collaborator-style pointer with a name tag that trails the cursor over a card.
demos.code:
let card = ui.add(my_card).rect;
FollowingPointer::new("Ada Lovelace").color(hex("#0EA5E9")).show(ui, card);

demos.name: Crosshair
demos.description: Hairlines track the pointer across the area, with an intersection ring and live coordinates.

demos.name: Target Cursor
demos.description: Spinning corner brackets follow the pointer and snap around whatever target it hovers.

demos.name: Magnet
demos.description: Wraps any content and pulls it toward a nearby pointer, springing back when it leaves.

demos.name: Confetti
demos.description: Confetti bursts from a point, tumbles in 3D and flutters down. Fire it from code or on click.

demos.name: Fireworks
demos.description: Rockets streak up and burst into glowing, falling sparks. Click to launch your own.

demos.name: Sticker Peel
demos.description: A die-cut sticker you drag to peel: the corner folds back along a crease, showing its paper back and a curl shadow.

demos.name: Magnet Lines
demos.description: A grid of short lines that all swivel to point at the pointer, glowing in the accent color nearby.

demos.name: Shape Blur
demos.description: Soft, out-of-focus outlines that snap into crisp focus wherever the pointer gets close.

demos.name: Lens
demos.description: A magnifying glass over any painted scene: the content is re-painted larger inside a glassy circular lens.

demos.name: Mask Reveal
demos.description: A circular mask follows the pointer and reveals an alternate version of the content underneath; it swells on hover.

demos.name: Animated Tooltip
demos.description: Overlapping avatars; the hovered one lifts and a name tooltip pops above it, swinging with the pointer on a loose spring.
demos.code:
let team = [Person::new("Sarah Chen", "Product Designer", hex("#8B5CF6"), hex("#EC4899")), /* ... */];
ui.add(AnimatedTooltip::new(&team));

demos.name: Scratch To Reveal
demos.description: A shimmering foil you scratch away with the pointer; past 50% the rest dissolves and it reports `revealed`. Self-scratches when idle.

demos.name: Compare Slider
demos.description: Before / after comparison of two painted scenes with a draggable divider and grab handle; sweeps on its own when idle.

demos.name: Card Stack
demos.description: A deck of photos that fans out as you reach it: hover draws a card up, click flips it into the middle.

demos.name: ASCII Wake
demos.description: A cube drawn in ink dots; the pointer drags a wake of characters through it that cools back to dots, and a press sends a ring out.

demos.name: Wake Slider
demos.description: A range made of thin bars with no thumb; drag fast and the bars you sweep past spring up in a wake behind the hand.

demos.name: Folding Bill
demos.description: A banknote simulated as cloth: grab it, drag it and fold it over itself; plain or with an engraved print.

demos.name: Heat Map
demos.description: Gray dots that melt into a glowing heat map under your cursor; press for the next shape.

demos.name: Generate
demos.description: Press Generate and an image resolves under frosted glass, broad shapes first.

demos.name: Image Accordion
demos.description: Hover a photo strip and it opens wide while its neighbours give way around it.

demos.name: Magnetic Select
demos.description: Press an option and it swells into an iridescent orb as the rest are pushed out of its way.

demos.name: Checklist
demos.description: Tick a task and the box pops full, the check draws itself in and the words strike out.
demos.code:
let mut tasks = vec![TodoItem::new("Water the ferns"), TodoItem::new("Reply to Ana")];
ui.add(TaskChecklist::new(&mut tasks).bounce(50.0).corner(20.0).box_size(18.0));

demos.name: Liquid Toggle
demos.description: A switch whose droplet stretches as it slides across the track and snaps round at the end.
demos.code:
let mut on = false;
ui.add(LiquidToggle::new(&mut on).speed(50.0).stretch(36.0));

demos.name: Now Playing
demos.description: A now-playing bar that opens into a full player and folds back as one piece.

demos.name: Slosh Slider
demos.description: A slider whose fill has weight: drag fast and the liquid sloshes past the handle before settling.

demos.name: Stacked Bars
demos.description: A month of visits as stacked bars: run along them and one day is ringed while a tooltip glides beside it; Day / Week regrows the bars.

demos.name: Emoji Reactions
demos.description: Press the button and the message turns into a pill of emoji; pick one and it flies down to its chip as the count rolls up.

demos.name: Voice Note
demos.description: Hold to record a waveform, slide left to bin it, let go to play it back.

demos.name: Time Scrubber
demos.description: Drag the ruler to set a time; fling it and it coasts with momentum to the nearest step.

demos.name: Label Input
demos.description: A field whose label rests inside like a placeholder and lifts into the top edge, opening a notch in the outline, when you focus it.

demos.name: Step Player
demos.description: Press play and each step fills as a bar, then eases on to the next dot.

demos.name: Glass Bubble
demos.description: Drag a ball of glass over a picture: it magnifies the middle, bends the rim and splits the colours at the edge.

demos.name: Slide to Confirm
demos.description: Push the handle across; past the mark it takes over, finishes itself and turns into a check.

demos.name: Pull to Refresh
demos.description: Pull the card down and it stretches while a ring of dots fills in; let go past the line to refresh.

demos.name: Escape Button
demos.description: A button that slides away from your cursor a few times, and then gives up.

demos.name: Create Menu
